specs.title: Weekly WhatsApp digest
specs.why: A weekly summary keeps the merchant engaged and surfaces problems they would not otherwise notice.
specs.scope: Send the owner a weekly summary of bookings, revenue, no-shows, top service and one actionable insight.
tasks: Add `scripts/digest-cron.ts`: add the job scheduled per tenant timezone
acceptance: Every active tenant receives one digest per week, verified by `pnpm test`
Digest figures match `/app/payouts` for the same period
`lib/insights.ts` returns one actionable item per tenant

specs.title: Staff accounts and assignment
specs.why: Multi-staff businesses are a large share of the target market and need per-staff calendars.
specs.scope: Per-staff calendars, service eligibility and commission splits, with a staff picker in the public flow.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: extend the `Staff` model with tenant scope
Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add the staff-service mapping table
acceptance: A staff session sees only its own bookings, verified by `pnpm test`
Commission appears as a `LedgerEntry` row per booking
An overlapping booking for one staff member returns HTTP 409
